name: Laravel MCP Chat (Tech Day) - PHP 8.3 (no Features)
postCreateCommand:
set -euxo pipefail
 && sudo apt-get update -y
 && sudo apt-get install -y sqlite3 libsqlite3-dev build-essential autoconf pkg-config
 && sudo docker-php-source extract
 && sudo docker-php-ext-configure sockets || true
 && sudo docker-php-ext-install -j"$(nproc)" sockets
 && sudo docker-php-ext-enable sockets
 && sudo docker-php-source delete
 && composer install
 && bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR=/usr/local/share/nvm; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] || (mkdir -p "$NVM_DIR" && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.39.7/install.sh | bash); . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install --lts && nvm use --lts && (command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && (npm ci || npm install))'
 && php -r "file_exists('database/database.sqlite') || touch('database/database.sqlite');"
 && php artisan key:generate
 && php artisan migrate --graceful --ansi || true
 && sudo mkdir -p /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d
 && sudo cp .devcontainer/php/xdebug.ini /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/99-xdebug.ini
 && php -m | grep -i sockets
 && php -v
